$comment: Source of truth for the LlamaIndex RAG MCP NiftyPM project. Generated and validated BEFORE any MCP tool calls. See s-niftypm references/niftypm-project-plan-schema.md for the format specification.

meta.generated_by: a-build agent with s-niftypm v2 (three-phase pipeline)

project.name: LlamaIndex RAG MCP
project.description: Local-first RAG MCP server for AI assistants. LlamaIndex pipeline with ChromaDB, BM25 hybrid retrieval, cross-encoder reranker, Ollama embeddings, and MCP protocol. Pre-fellowship scaffold for NeurMantiq. Current version: v1.4.0 (2026-05-31). Status: RAG retrieval layer validated. 19 ADRs, 10+ experiments completed.

milestones.name: 🔴 M2: Reranker Fix + Evaluation (Current Sprint)
milestones.description: Active sprint: P0 reranker swap, P2 eval harness, P1 contextual retrieval

milestones.name: 🧠 M4: NeurMantiq Phase 1 Readiness
milestones.description: Arabic RAG, bge-m3 eval, eval harness prep

tasks.name: [P0] Swap reranker → gte-reranker-modernbert-base
tasks.description: P0 — Quick win, LOW effort, HIGH impact. Replace cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 with Alibaba-NLP/gte-reranker-modernbert-base (149M params, Hit@1 83.0%, 2-3x faster than BERT-family). Directly addresses the 27% reranker regression from Exp 10.
subtasks: Verify ONNX export / local-inference feasibility on consumer hardware
A/B against current reranker on FreshStack LangChain + Qasper
Compare vs rerank-off baseline (must beat 0.738 Coverage@20 hybrid)
Write experiment protocol + results, update ADR if adopted

tasks.name: [P1] Contextual retrieval (Anthropic chunk contextualisation)
tasks.description: P1 — MEDIUM effort, HIGH impact (+5-7pp). Anthropic-style: prepend LLM-generated context summary to each chunk before embedding. Use local Ollama LLM at INDEX time.
subtasks: Design context-summary prompt (section headers, project names, technical terms)
Add ingestion-pipeline step in LlamaIndex to contextualise chunks pre-embedding
Benchmark on FreshStack Laravel/LangChain
Measure index-time cost on consumer hardware; write ADR

tasks.name: [P2] Adopt FreshStack + RAGAS evaluation harness
tasks.description: P2 — MEDIUM effort. FreshStack (NeurIPS 2025) + RAGAS for repeatable evaluation. Laravel 10/11 domain is directly relevant to NeurMantiq stack.
subtasks: Integrate FreshStack harness (Laravel domain first)
Build custom eval set: 50-100 real queries with hand-annotated ground-truth chunks
Wire RAGAS metrics into a repeatable eval script
Document 'swap one variable → re-run evals → commit if improved' workflow

tasks.name: [P5] Optional: upgrade embeddings to Qwen3-Embedding-4B (Q4)
tasks.description: P5 — LOW effort, optional. Qwen3-Embedding-4B Q4_K_M (~2.5GB VRAM) gains ~7 MTEB points + better code retrieval. Current qwen3:0.6b is well-chosen, so this is optional.
subtasks: Benchmark Qwen3-Embedding-4B (Q4) vs 0.6b on local hardware (latency + VRAM)
Run retrieval quality A/B on FreshStack + custom eval set
Decide based on quality gain vs ingestion-throughput cost

tasks.name: [P3] Parent-document retrieval
tasks.description: P3 — LOW effort (LlamaIndex built-in). Embed small chunks, return parent section to LLM. Use SentenceWindowNodeParser or AutoMergingRetriever.
subtasks: Prototype AutoMergingRetriever / SentenceWindowNodeParser in the pipeline
Verify ChromaDB metadata supports parent linkage
Benchmark answer quality vs current flat-chunk retrieval

tasks.name: [P4] HyDE for vague queries (optional, flag-gated)
tasks.description: P4 — LOW effort, optional. Generate hypothetical answer, embed THAT instead of raw query. +15-20% on vague queries. Gate behind a flag (default off).
subtasks: Add optional pre-retrieval HyDE step (local Ollama LLM)
Implement fallback to direct query embedding if confidence low
Gate behind a flag (default off); benchmark on vague-query subset

tasks.name: [C] ColBERT late-interaction retrieval (architectural bet)
tasks.description: Backlog — ColBERT-style late interaction. Candidates: jina-colbert-v2, mxbai-colbert-large-v1. Best for exact token matching (code, APIs). Cost: per-token vectors, needs multi-vector store.
subtasks: Evaluate multi-vector store options vs ChromaDB
Prototype on technical/code query subset
Compare quality + storage cost vs gte-reranker baseline

tasks.name: [Decision] Skip LightRAG/GraphRAG for now
tasks.description: Decision log: SKIP LightRAG/GraphRAG. Outperforms naive RAG on comprehensiveness but adds 2.3x latency. Revisit only if NeurMantiq needs multi-hop reasoning.

tasks.name: OpenSpec: Login watcher installer (macOS LaunchAgent)
tasks.description: Adds rag-mcp install-login-watcher command: macOS LaunchAgent generator for auto-starting the file watcher at login. macOS-only.
subtasks: LaunchAgent planning + core utilities
Plist write + launchctl bootstrap/bootout/kickstart operations
CLI + interactive wizard
Initial catch-up ingestion wired to ingest_path_async
Tests + docs

tasks.name: EVAL-001: Integrate FreshStack evaluation harness (Laravel domain first)
tasks.description: Clone and integrate FreshStack benchmark. Start with Laravel 10/11. Verify α-nDCG@10, Coverage@20, Recall@50 metrics. Run baseline against v1.4.0.

tasks.name: EVAL-002: Build custom eval set — 50-100 hand-annotated technical queries
tasks.description: Curate 50-100 real-world technical queries with hand-annotated ground-truth chunks. Source: PyPI docs, LlamaIndex docs, ChromaDB docs, MCP spec, project source.

tasks.name: EVAL-003: Wire RAGAS metrics into CI pipeline
tasks.description: Integrate RAGAS (Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, Context Recall, Context Precision) into CI. Non-regression: each PR must pass threshold.

tasks.name: EVAL-004: Build Arabic/multilingual test corpus for NeurMantiq pre-validation
tasks.description: Create 10-20 mixed Arabic-English legal/religious texts with 20-30 annotated queries. Validate Arabic chunking, embeddings, metadata extraction, multilingual reranker.

tasks.name: EVAL-005: Re-run Exp 1 (Reranker threshold calibration) on FreshStack corpus
tasks.description: Replication: re-run Exp 1 threshold calibration on FreshStack (~200 queries). Literature confirms small-corpus RAG does NOT generalise to larger corpora.

tasks.name: EVAL-006: Re-run Exp 2 (Embedding model comparison) on FreshStack + custom eval set
tasks.description: Replication: re-run embedding comparison on FreshStack + custom set. Verify qwen3:0.6b maintains perfect retrieval at scale; check if larger models overtake it.

tasks.name: EVAL-007: Document Exp 5 as corpus-size generalisation failure
tasks.description: Documentation: Exp 5 RERANK_MAX_FETCH=50 was calibrated on small corpus and superseded by Exp 10. Write REPLICATION_NOTE.md. Cross-reference De Oliveira & Cerqueira (2026).

tasks.name: Cross-reference: NeurMantiq Phase 1 RAG dependency
tasks.description: Prerequisite: RAG MCP server must be stable before NeurMantiq Phase 1. The reranker regression must be fixed before ingesting real jurisprudence/fatwa corpora.

tasks.name: Arabic/multilingual RAG validation (pre-Phase 1)
tasks.description: Before ingesting real NeurMantiq corpora: verify Arabic text support in chunking/embeddings, test mixed PDF ingestion (OCR), validate non-Latin metadata extraction, evaluate multilingual reranker.
subtasks: Verify Arabic text support in chunking + embeddings
Test ingestion of mixed Arabic-English PDFs (Tesseract/OCR)
Validate metadata extraction works with non-Latin-script headings
Evaluate multilingual reranker vs monolingual gte-reranker
Document corpus ingestion workflow for supervised domain

tasks.name: Consider bge-m3 for multilingual NeurMantiq embedding strategy
tasks.description: bge-m3 produces dense+sparse+ColBERT from single model. May be stronger fit for mixed Arabic-English natural language than for original technical docs.
subtasks: Test bge-m3 embedding quality on Arabic-English jurisprudence sample corpus
Compare single-model dense+sparse vs current Qwen3 + separate BM25
Evaluate local inference cost (568M params, ~1.2GB)

tasks.name: Ensure evaluation harness ready before NeurMantiq Phase 1 ingestion
tasks.description: P2 task (AIE-22) should be completed before NeurMantiq Phase 1 begins. FreshStack Laravel domain is directly relevant (NeurMantiq stack: Laravel + Inertia + React).

Story points >0 for active tasks, null for decisions/notes
